limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the counter wrap but also made `ready_a` high during reset, allowed input acceptance on the first clock after reset, and suppressed `valid_b` during stalls at count five, all of which differ from the reference.
The test required constant readiness and expected `valid_b` only on the sixth accepted bit, so it confirmed the rewrite’s assumptions rather than catching the changes to reset and stall behavior.
